_readme: Fill from OFFICIAL schedules only. Every event and holiday needs a 'source' URL. Set verified_through per kind to the last date you checked. Until every kind is verified through a spread's expiration, the risk engine rejects that spread. FOMC: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (statement 14:00 ET, use -04:00/-05:00 offsets). CPI/NFP: bls.gov schedules (08:30 ET) or run `python -m qqq.cli macro-refresh` with FRED_API_KEY set.
